name: RC Car Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: a low orange RC racing car with headlight eyes, a grinning grille, teal wheel hubs and boost flames
entry: It races round courtyards at full speed and flips off ramps. It brings the ball back, but only sometimes.
how: Use a RC Remote on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Earth Power in this form.
